prompts.label: 전체
prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single production UI category icon for the CREFANS category chip, displayed at 20x20 CSS pixels.
Reference image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match ONLY the FIRST ROW labeled 01 라운드 플랫. Do not copy any other row, text, chips, board or background.
Primary request: create the 전체 category icon: four equally sized rounded squares arranged as a compact 2 by 2 grid, alternating blue and violet.
Style: rounded flat filled geometric illustration, friendly clean shapes, crisp smooth contours, restrained 2-3 solid colors, no outline, no 3D, no drop shadow, no glossy shine, no gradients or texture. Strong silhouette legible at tiny size.
Composition: ONE isolated icon centered in a square, main silhouette occupies about 84 percent of both canvas dimensions, consistent 8 percent transparent margin. Never a sheet or multiple options.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. No white tile, no circle background, no lettering, no label, no watermark. The output is only this one icon.

catalog uses shared icons; unknown label has no unrelated icon
previously requested solid red like and outline unlike

firstFailuresAndCorrections.failure: Mobile explore category row began16px too far inward because its margin shorthand overwrote common horizontal margins.
firstFailuresAndCorrections.correction: Use margin-block only. Retest mobile initial16px chip inset and edge-to-edge scroll viewport.

firstFailuresAndCorrections.failure: Initial release preparation expected an unrelated local-only catalog anchor absent in production.
firstFailuresAndCorrections.correction: Use existing production search-section anchor; no unrelated catalog changes included.

firstFailuresAndCorrections.failure: Test assumed every PC row could scroll more than80px; wide explore had33px overflow.
firstFailuresAndCorrections.correction: Bound scroll expectations to measured overflow. Product unchanged.

firstFailuresAndCorrections.failure: Service feed filter refresh replaced/moved the row during synthetic dragging. Network idle alone did not guarantee final displayed state.
firstFailuresAndCorrections.correction: Wait for final fixture post to be visible before measuring and dragging; all19 checks passed on local/image/production. Product unchanged.
